title: Дебаты: "Жизнь сегодня" (Монолог)
description: Посмотри на пример. Теперь самостоятельно составь мини-выступление «Как изменилась жизнь подростков», используя подсказки ниже, а затем успей рассказать за 60 сек.

conditions.label: Минимум 2 раза Present Perfect Continuous
conditions.hint: Teenagers have been using smartphones more often.

conditions.label: Лексика подростков и технологий
conditions.hint: smartphones, the Internet, social media, online

monologue: Now teenagers have been using smartphones and social media more than before. They have been spending many hours online, chatting and watching videos, scrolling through their phones, instead of meeting friends in person. Now teenagers are doing homework on the Internet and learning from short clips, while before they used books and talked with classmates face to face. Many teens feel more connected but also more distracted because notifications are interrupting them. Life for teenagers today is more digital and faster than it used to be.
